en.answer: Even if <<11069>> does not have <<9729>> attached to it as an Xyz Material when it's Xyz Summoned, as long as <<9729>> is attached to it afterwards by an effect like <<10030>>, the battle damage inflicted by <<11069>> is not halved.
en.question: If <<9729>> is attached to <<11069>> afterwards by the effect of <<10030>>, is the battle damage of that <<11069>> inflicted to the opponent still halved?
en.title: If <<9729>> is attached to <<11069>> afterwards by the effect of <<10030>>, is the battle damage of that <<11069>> inflicted to the opponent still halved?

ja.answer: 「<<11069>>」のエクシーズ召喚の際に、「<<9729>>」をエクシーズ素材としていない場合でも、「<<10030>>」の効果によって、「<<9729>>」を後から「<<11069>>」のエクシーズ素材としたのであれば、その「<<11069>>」が相手に与える戦闘ダメージは半分にはなりません。
